entities.description: A woman with dark skin and short hair stands in profile facing right, wearing a colorful geometric patterned dress in red, green, yellow, and black, with a cream-colored fringed shawl draped over her shoulders. She holds a young child on her left hip, who is wearing a beige sleeveless top, and carries a black DSLR camera with a large lens in her right hand.
